# Keenetic
> Keenetic provides Wi‑Fi routers, mesh systems, and network software with documentation, support, downloads, and product resources.

Keenetic’s site includes product information, support resources, a knowledge base, firmware and app downloads, and regional pages for managing home and small-office networking devices.

## Main Site
- [Keenetic Home](https://keenetic.io/): Main entry point for Keenetic products, networking solutions, and support resources.
- [Products](https://keenetic.io/products): Overview of Keenetic routers, mesh systems, and related networking hardware.
- [Support](https://keenetic.io/support): Central support area for help articles, manuals, and troubleshooting resources.
- [Downloads](https://keenetic.io/downloads): Firmware, software, mobile apps, and other downloadable resources for Keenetic devices.
- [Blog](https://keenetic.io/blog): News, announcements, and articles about Keenetic products and networking topics.
- [Where to Buy](https://keenetic.io/where-to-buy): Regional purchasing and reseller information for Keenetic products.

## Products
- [Wi‑Fi Routers](https://keenetic.io/products/wifi-routers): Product listings for Keenetic wireless routers for home and office networking.
- [Mesh Wi‑Fi Systems](https://keenetic.io/products/mesh-wifi-systems): Mesh-capable devices and systems for whole-home wireless coverage.
- [DSL Modem Routers](https://keenetic.io/products/dsl-modem-routers): Integrated DSL modem router models for broadband connectivity.
- [4G/5G Routers](https://keenetic.io/products/4g-5g-routers): Cellular-enabled routers for mobile broadband and backup internet access.
- [Repeaters and Extenders](https://keenetic.io/products/repeaters-and-extenders): Devices for extending wireless coverage and improving signal reach.
- [Switches and Accessories](https://keenetic.io/products/accessories): Networking accessories and complementary hardware for Keenetic deployments.

## Support Resources
- [Support Center](https://keenetic.io/support): Starting point for troubleshooting, setup help, and product assistance.
- [Knowledge Base](https://keenetic.io/support/knowledge-base): Help articles covering setup, configuration, and common networking issues.
- [User Manuals](https://keenetic.io/support/manuals): Product manuals and documentation for installation and operation.
- [FAQ](https://keenetic.io/support/faq): Frequently asked questions about Keenetic devices, software, and features.
- [Warranty and Service](https://keenetic.io/support/warranty): Warranty terms, repair, and service information for supported regions.
- [Contact Support](https://keenetic.io/support/contact): Contact options for obtaining technical assistance from Keenetic.

## Downloads
- [Downloads Home](https://keenetic.io/downloads): Central page for firmware, utilities, and application downloads.
- [Firmware](https://keenetic.io/downloads/firmware): Firmware packages and release resources for Keenetic devices.
- [Mobile Apps](https://keenetic.io/downloads/mobile-apps): Keenetic mobile application downloads for device management and monitoring.
- [Desktop Utilities](https://keenetic.io/downloads/utilities): Supporting tools and utilities for configuring and maintaining Keenetic hardware.
- [Release Notes](https://keenetic.io/downloads/release-notes): Version histories and change summaries for firmware and software updates.

## Software and Features
- [KeeneticOS](https://keenetic.io/keeneticos): Overview of Keenetic’s operating system and its networking capabilities.
- [Mesh Wi‑Fi](https://keenetic.io/features/mesh-wifi): Information about Keenetic mesh networking and seamless wireless coverage.
- [Mobile App](https://keenetic.io/features/mobile-app): Features of the Keenetic app for remote management and monitoring.
- [VPN](https://keenetic.io/features/vpn): VPN-related functionality for secure remote access and network connectivity.
- [Parental Control](https://keenetic.io/features/parental-control): Tools for managing internet access and content restrictions.
- [Network Security](https://keenetic.io/features/security): Security features for protecting home and small-office networks.

## Setup and Guides
- [Getting Started](https://keenetic.io/support/getting-started): Initial setup guidance for new Keenetic devices and networks.
- [Internet Connection Setup](https://keenetic.io/support/internet-setup): Instructions for configuring WAN and ISP connection settings.
- [Wi‑Fi Configuration](https://keenetic.io/support/wifi-setup): Guides for wireless network setup, optimization, and troubleshooting.
- [Mesh Setup](https://keenetic.io/support/mesh-setup): Steps for creating and managing a Keenetic mesh network.
- [Firmware Update Guide](https://keenetic.io/support/firmware-update): Instructions for updating device firmware safely and correctly.
- [Remote Access Setup](https://keenetic.io/support/remote-access): Guidance for enabling remote administration and access features.

## Blog and News
- [Blog Home](https://keenetic.io/blog): Collection of articles, updates, and networking-related posts from Keenetic.
- [News](https://keenetic.io/blog/news): Official announcements about products, releases, and company updates.
- [Product Updates](https://keenetic.io/blog/product-updates): Articles describing new features, firmware changes, and device improvements.
- [How‑to Articles](https://keenetic.io/blog/how-to): Practical networking tips and configuration walkthroughs.
- [Security Articles](https://keenetic.io/blog/security): Posts focused on network protection, privacy, and secure configuration.

## Company and Regional
- [About Keenetic](https://keenetic.io/about): Company background and overview of Keenetic’s networking mission.
- [Partners](https://keenetic.io/partners): Information for channel partners, distributors, and resellers.
- [Press](https://keenetic.io/press): Media resources and press-related company information.
- [Legal](https://keenetic.io/legal): Legal notices, policies, and terms related to Keenetic services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://keenetic.io/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information for site visitors and users.
- [Regional Sites](https://keenetic.io/regions): Access to country- or region-specific Keenetic pages and resources.
